headword: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}

definitions.explanation: A governing body at the regional or municipal level, including prefectures, cities, towns, and villages. Responsible for local administration, public services, and community governance.

examples.japanese: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる。
{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}が{独自|どくじ}の{支援策|しえんさく}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The local government announced its own support measures.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}が{人口減少|じんこうげんしょう}という{課題|かだい}に{直面|ちょくめん}している。
examples.english: Many local governments are facing the challenge of population decline.

notes: Compound of {地方|ちほう} (local/regional) + {自治体|じちたい} (self-governing body). Often shortened to {自治体|じちたい} in conversation and news. In Japan, {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい} includes {都道府県|とどうふけん} (prefectures) and {市町村|しちょうそん} (cities, towns, and villages). Common collocations: {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}の{取|と}り{組|く}み (local government initiatives), {地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}の{財政|ざいせい} (local government finances).
